evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Jules says 'This should take me about five to ten minutes' but never frames the 10–15 minute promise, never mentions 'a quote you can depend on,' and never waits for a yes before diving into logistics.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Not asked. Jules never asks 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' or any equivalent. Jumps straight into location details.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by the customer.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns were raised to reflect back.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (townhome), floor/stories (2), bedrooms (1 bed + 1 law), furniture list (mattress, bed frame, hutch, media console, dining table, coffee table, bookcase, sectional sofa), special considerations (storage unit, additional stop to residential home), second address (1514 Skyline, Barnett TX 75043), square footage estimate for destination (~2000 sq ft, 2 story). All seven logistics items covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Jules asks 'So wanna make sure you need help packing dishes and some of the furniture' — packing is confirmed as needed.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Jules asks 'Usually for town homes this size, we see around thirty to forty boxes to be moved, do you think you're going to be within that range?' and addresses overflow by noting 'We can, we're gonna bring you know a box a little bit extra.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Jules provides $1,680 for 8 hours at $210/hour + packing materials $100–$200. Anchored to home size and personalized to the packing and multiple stops involved.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Jules discloses hourly rate ($210 for two movers), packing materials cost ($100–$200), 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute proration, no hidden fees (fuel, disassemble/reassembly, etc.). Full transparency. Also mentions weekday discount ($202 vs $210). Complete framing present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked. Jules moves directly to 'Awesome, alright. Well yeah, right now we have availability on Saturday October 24th' without checking whether the estimate feels fair or holding silence.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No closing loop attempted. Jules never says 'Does that put those to rest?' or revisits any concerns, because no concerns were ever elicited.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Jules never asks 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or any variant before booking.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Never asked. Jules does not ask 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or equivalent.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Jules never says 'Would you like our help with your move?' The customer proactively agrees ('Yeah, uh-huh and now let's do that') but the rep does not make an explicit ask.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Jules confirms date (October 24th, 8:30–9 AM), mentions a confirmation email will be sent, asks customer to verify addresses/phone/date/time in the email, and mentions movers will be introduced a few days before and will call on move day. However, final confirmation of phone number on the call itself is not explicitly stated, arrival window is given (8:30–9 AM) but not confirmed as acceptable by customer, and crew size and move-specific notes are not discussed or confirmed.

top_strength: Jules gathered comprehensive logistics details across all seven items (property type, floors, rooms, furniture list, special considerations, multiple addresses, storage location) and explained pricing structure and terms (hourly rate, packing materials, minimums, proration, no hidden fees) with full transparency.
coaching_note: Critical gap: Never asked 'What are your biggest concerns about this move?' (Section 2 foundation), never checked if the estimate felt fair (Section 4), never delivered the Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage), and never made an explicit ask for the business — the customer agreed unprompted, but that is not the same as 'Would you like our help with your move?' Rebuild the middle of the call around their agenda and concerns, and always anchor the transition to booking with an explicit ask.
